name: Cat
about: A small cat that lives on the screen, with its own moods and gestures. Built into every Molty; install only for a newer version.
look: A slim lavender cat drawn as a fine outline: pointy ears pink inside, round green eyes, a pink nose, whiskers, a white chest. A long darker tail. It sits, stands, lies in a loaf and walks.

moods.idle: sits with its chest breathing, ears swiveling, tail tip curling, slow blinks
moods.listening: both ears prick toward you and it goes still, only the tail tip twitching
moods.thinking: eyes half shut, an ear back, the tail sweeping slowly; now and then a tilt
moods.speaking: the chin lifts with each meow and the ears move a little
moods.happy: slow blinks, the tail up with a quivering tip, kneading with its front paws
moods.sleepy: lies down into a loaf, paws tucked, the tail along its side, eyes closed, breathing slowly
moods.surprised: jumps up with the back arched high, fur standing up, the tail a bottle brush, ears flat

gestures.wiggle: crouches low and shimmies its hips as if about to pounce, the tail tip twitching
gestures.nod: a slow cat nod: the eyes close, the head sinks and comes back up
gestures.shake_head: rattles its head quickly, the ears flapping, then one last ear flick
gestures.bounce: crouches, wiggles its bum and pounces forward, landing in a play crouch
gestures.peek: goes low with only its head up, ears pricked, the eyes sweeping slowly
gestures.glance_left: its ears turn to its left first, then the eyes and the head follow
gestures.glance_right: its ears turn to its right first, then the eyes and the head follow
gestures.blink: a blink with a little ear flick
gestures.wobble: a whole-body shake from the head down to the tail, the fur puffing out
gestures.stretch: front paws walk out and the chest sinks low in a long stretch, then it sits back up
gestures.look_up: tips its head right back at a bird overhead, the jaw chattering
gestures.yawn: a big yawn, the jaw wide with the tongue curled, ears flat, then a lick

inspect.about: goes low and peers, the eyes sweeping slowly

gestures.paddle: bats at something with one paw, the other paw joining once
gestures.eat: a red bowl of milk on the floor; it leans down and laps, ears and tail moving, then licks its lips
gestures.yarn: a ball of yarn rolls in; it watches, crouches, wiggles and pounces, then bats it away
gestures.shaken: jostled by the shake and dizzy a moment, it shakes it off like a wet cat and looks at you, ready

walk.about: gets up and walks a few steps across the floor, then settles again
